scripts.test:sim: pnpm test:sim:node && pnpm test:sim:browser && pnpm --filter @robosim/renderer-2d run test:browser && pnpm --filter @robosim/circuit-canvas run test:browser
scripts.test:sim:browser: pnpm --filter @robosim/board-avr-uno run test:browser && pnpm --filter @robosim/grader run test:browser

scripts.test:sim:node: turbo run build --filter=@robosim/grader^... --filter=@robosim/renderer-2d^... && pnpm --filter @robosim/board-avr-uno run test:conformance && pnpm --filter @robosim/grader run test:golden && pnpm --filter @robosim/grader run test:long
scripts.golden:update: turbo run build --filter=@robosim/grader^... && pnpm --filter @robosim/grader run golden:update
scripts.firmware:gen: turbo run build --filter=@robosim/compiler && pnpm --filter @robosim/compiler run gen:demos
